title: UIBC MCP authorization report line
description: One line of a JSON Lines file produced by `uibc_core.pyz verify-mcp-authz --report`. The line describes one MCP authorization observation and the findings the reader raised on it. A verdict travels with its codes because a verdict without findings is an opinion; a consumer comparing two verifiers has to line up finding by finding.

vector.description: The corpus member this line is about, as the caller named it.

result.description: PASS means no finding was raised; FAIL means at least one was; ERROR means the observation could not be read at all. ERROR is not a pass.

verdict.description: `valid` exactly when `codes` is empty; null only on an ERROR line, where no verdict was reached.

codes.description: The findings the reader raised, in the order it reached them. Extra codes are reported, not suppressed: a condition that holds must be named.

exit.description: 0 for a valid verdict, 1 for a refusal, 3 when nothing could be judged.

error.description: Present only on an ERROR line, and required there: an error with no reason is indistinguishable from a silent refusal.

$comment: Cross-field rules the subset here cannot express: result PASS iff exit 0 iff codes empty; result FAIL iff exit 1 iff codes non-empty; result ERROR iff exit 3 iff verdict null and codes empty and error present.
